feature.name: Unified workbench homepage
feature.objective: Make the repository's discovery, theme editing and development guidance approachable through one polished, accessible entry point.
acceptance_criteria: Show reliable source and reference counts computed at build time.
Link to the working component explorer and original design studio.
Preserve existing keyboard-first searchable tool directory without extra list items.
Remain responsive at 375px and 1280px, with reduced-motion-friendly behavior.
All relevant repository and browser CI checks pass.

source_of_truth.authority_rule: Existing searchable tool directory remains functional and authoritative for listed tools.

design_system.contrast_review: Browser automated checks and manual review

component_registry.purpose: Explain entry points to existing workbenches

interactions.success_condition: Existing directory filters and count correct
Open local explorer or token studio
interactions.failure_condition: Unavailable page detected by browser checks

data_contracts.error_state: build fails instead of stale counts

tool_runs.decisions: No paid or additional browser runtime dependencies introduced

quality_gates.security_review: No external network fetches or scripts

decisions.decision: Homepage connects existing workspaces without installing external design libraries
decisions.reason: Keep compatibility, permissions, security and zero-cost guarantees.

decisions.decision: Metrics come from validated source index
decisions.reason: Prevent stale presentation numbers when catalogue changes.

handoff.next_stage: verify tests and merge if all required checks pass
